study_name: Study 3: BI Table A1 English translations, 90-word reference pilot
ma_instructions: Arrange the English words according to their meanings. Similar words should be near each other; very different words should be far apart.
In the first arrangement, place all 90 words inside the white circle. Later arrangements contain smaller word groups chosen from earlier placements.
This is a reference pilot. The original paper used Chinese words; these English translations are not yet validated as the final UK stimulus set.
